prior_summary: Blue-frame Cartesian pose targets make pickup, closure, lift and early carry transform with the causally observed blue pose while preserving robot and destination conditioning.
applicable_conditions: Prefer with drawer_position > 0.26 m when blue is outside and displaced or rotated relative to the narrow demonstrated pickup region. Red may still be in the demonstrated pad-release overlap. source_object must be blue and destination_field blue_goal.
termination_guidance: Terminate only under the unchanged simultaneous drawer-open, red-on-pad and blue-inside evaluator expression. Observed gripper release and high retreat are continuation context, not added success conditions.
limitations: Does not create reachability or collision invariance, freezes the observed blue frame for one chunk, and has no demonstrated failed-grasp, drop, lip-impact or recovery behavior. Prefer the destination-frame policy once drawer alignment dominates.
